_what_this_is: Phase 4's remaining acceptance: install.ps1 taking a machine with nothing on it to a green end-to-end self-test in one run. The guest was installed from a Windows 11 ISO in this session, had no Python, no git and auditing switched off, and every step below was performed by the installer rather than prepared for it.
_what_this_does_not_show: The unflagged install path. The guest has 6 GB of RAM and the host could not spare 8 GB for it, so install.ps1 ran with -NoDashboard - which is the flag its own preflight names, and which it ignored until this run (docs/CORRECTIONS.md correction 19). The Streamlit dashboard and the ml-engine are therefore not installed or exercised here. It also does not show a second run on the same machine: this is a first install, not an upgrade.
